name: Litia
source: [url=/c11424]Ria[/url]'s and [url=/c11425]Fine[/url]'s mentor. Litia was the head of some small sect after the last war before she and most of the sect were killed during the fight with one of the large sects. From her Fine got the idea to stop all the fighting in this world.
